Name: Waterboy NPC
Author: leincognite
Description:
Hello everyone! 
So, this is my first time making a mod, so it's obviously not perfect, I still don't know how to a heart event, so he still doesn't have one :(
You can marry him, he still has no house but I will fix that as soon as I can, and he has at least 70+ lines at the moment.
For this mod you should only need SMAPI and Content Patcher :)
-This is still a WIP and I will be updating this in the future.
-He loves Melon, peaches and pancakes, he likes pizza, cookies, truffle and poppyseed muffin, and he hates spaghetti and beer.
